summary: CAIR Action endorsed Lieber in the 2026 general election and Vote for Peace rated her an Ally, both organizations that assess Gaza and ceasefire positions. A 2024 CAIR guide, written when Lieber ran for county supervisor, described her as an outspoken supporter of ceasefire and Palestinian rights, though the dates of the underlying statements are unknown. Activist Samir Laymoun also expressed general-phase support.
